storyCards.headline: I Fought The Law: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Bobby Fuller Four's "I Fought The Law" reached #9 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #9 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 11 weeks on the chart.

I Fought The Law was released in 1966.

"I Fought The Law" by Bobby Fuller Four.
